title: Can Japanese People Read Chinese? (Mandarin, Simplified)
summary: Yuta, a Japanese YouTuber, tests how much simplified Chinese a Japanese person can read, working with a Mandarin speaker. The video shows where shared kanji help and where meanings differ.
why: HN uses it to answer whether Japanese speakers can read Chinese: they can guess a lot, but not reliably.

quote.text: That Japanese Man Yuta has a great video demonstrating just how much Chinese script do ordinary Japanese folk understand
